proposals.rationale: Helps prevent feature_chain failures despite correct geometry. The first attempt produced the same measured geometry as the successful second attempt, and the prior library supports this structural guidance; the precise failing relationship remains unknown.

proposals.rationale: Helps retries distinguish feature-history problems from execution or geometry problems. This feedback-and-repair approach has prior support and directly addresses the observed first-attempt failure.

Helps bound retry cost when a third attempt has low expected value. The current run and both supported prior candidates succeeded in two attempts, while the reported three-attempt failures remained unsuccessful. This is an unvalidated cost tradeoff that could prevent recovery on a third attempt.
